## ATDD

For each task, read `conventions/atdd-bun.profiles/atdd-bun.profiles.presets.convention.yaml` in `node_modules/@afokapu/atdd-bun` and propose the governing profile(s). If the human has not selected them, ask them to choose; do not activate or deactivate profiles yourself. Then read the matching `conventions/_profiles/<profile>.yaml` registry and only the convention files it identifies as relevant.

Follow the applicable conventions and their gates. Enter at the stage that fits the task; do not assume a linear lifecycle.

Never modify the toolkit itself (`node_modules/@afokapu/atdd-bun`) or its generated files. Change only its configuration, and loosen it only when the user asks.
